title: 第十九章：她真的是少爷（上）
content_zh:
贺峰房中自然又是两道嘹亮而绵久的大叫声，泡在早早准备好，却又温凉适宜的药水里，一时间既是痛苦，又是舒服，令人陶醉不已，让贺峰不止一次的认为自己有受虐倾向，不过今天打完这惨烈的一架，让贺峰彻底的清楚了，自己真的没有受虐倾向，他可以发誓，真的一点都没有。

    不过，今天却很是有些反常，上一次打完架，再擦药的时候就不知不觉的睡着了去，而这次，虽然身体懒洋洋的一样一动都不想动，但精神却并没有想象中的那么疲累，反而脑海中还在不断的回想着刚才那场打斗的过程，就像是在电影院里看电影一般，而区别就是，他从参与者变成了唯一的一个围观者。

    贺峰就这样看着，虽然对方生在自己身上的事都很是不理解，但现在却已经能够做到坦然接受，无畏无惧了。

    而现在的贺峰在观看战斗时，去发现自己就好像是看慢镜头一样，不仅如此，把所有人的每一个动作，都看得特别清楚，甚至他都能找出好多自己当时应对不太恰当的地方。例如，在他转身打倒金道时的那一击，他如果不是用膝顶，而是直接一脚踹出，效果不仅更好，而且由于距离原因，自己也不会再像当时打的那么艰辛狼狈了；再比如，韦明在扑向自己的时候，倘若能够把握好其中的空档，先将前方的金道踹倒，然后顺势一个重肘下压打向因为前扑而趴在地上的韦明，相比先前的战斗方法会更省力。

    值得说的一点就是，在他的意识世界里，并不像真正的打斗一样，中间有着许多的停顿，现在贺峰观看并且在不断分析的战斗过程，是没有一点停顿的，中间没有那个素袍书生的出现，所以导致贺峰在这一段，只看到了一个很是滑稽的场面，四人相对，各有怒容，却在突然之间，很是默契的一起动手，然后四败俱伤，之后每个人就安静了休息了一段的时间，最后一击之后，就彻底的结束了，李纯最后起来恐吓的那一段没有出现，至于之后的情节，则更是没有出现半点。

    这场战斗的回放本就是在意识之中，虽说贺峰自觉自己没有睡着，但是他现在却是在闭着眼睛，而正在他享受这种特殊的战后总结的时候，猛然间，他却感到一种莫名的压力，这种压力不是来自于外界，而是直摄心神，让他惊恐莫名，但却又无法回避，仅仅是在那一瞬之间，他便已汗流浃背。

    睁开眼，忽的一道亮光映进眼帘，却原来是已经天亮了。贺峰站起身来活动了下筋骨，顿觉浑身发酸，就像是一台早已生了锈的机器，现在却突然间运作了起来一般，贺峰想了想，今天还是不要炼体了，稍稍晨跑一下，简单活动下身体算了。

    贺峰下地穿衣服时，虽然全身上下疼到也算不上，但每动一下，还是会觉得浑身酸的难受，连带的，那一点点的痛感，也觉得那么明显，那么嚣张的凌虐着贺峰的神经。

    今天晨起并没有见到李纯，贺峰就顺便问了句，不想得到的却是月儿那惊讶的呼声，然后就一溜跑了出去不见了。

    今天的晨练开始之后，对贺峰来说，真可谓不下于一场颇为剧烈的战斗了，直练的满头大汗，汗流浃背。

    “我不是受虐狂，我不是受虐狂，我不是受虐狂，••••••”贺峰一边不停地锻炼着身体，同时心中也在不停的呐喊着，随着贺峰跑一圈步，然后打一套太极，之后接着跑步打太极•••，如此往复循环，身上的酸痛感不知是真的下去了，还是贺峰习惯了，总之感觉不太明显了，但却不能停下来，因为一停下来，就会又回到最初的那种状态，全身像是生锈许久了的机器一样难受。而贺峰之所以在心中一遍又一遍的高声呐喊，却是因为在他锻炼身体的时候，那种酸痛的感觉，一直不增不减，而且在他的内心深处，竟然隐隐的还很享受这种酸中带痛的感觉，这让曾经果断的否认自己有受虐狂倾向的贺峰如何能够收的了？不过这些话也就能在心里呐喊一下，不然，别人一定不会介意想当然的认为一下，贺家大少爷已经疯了的这个事实。

    直到贺峰跑了二十多圈的时候，身上的酸痛感才算是开始慢慢地降了下去，这让贺峰心中暗暗松了口气，虽然贺峰很是惊讶于自己今天能跑二十多圈还没感到累这一强悍表现，但不代表他就愿意自己就这样一直跑下去，而无法自主的停下来。

    停下来的贺峰惬意的伸展双臂，摆出一个仰面朝天，拥抱自然的姿势，虽然这样的比喻有些自恋，而且还有些自恋，但是对于一个近乎拥有自恋狂的人来讲，无疑这样的比喻才是最贴近贺峰现在内心的想法。

    不过贺峰却并不只是为了摆一个酷酷的姿势，然后让别人观礼膜拜自己的。深深吸了口气，这口气有多深不知道，只能看到贺峰的胸膛像是一个气球一般慢慢的鼓了起来，然后就又是肚子。然后就一直保持着这样鼓鼓的状态，直到有寻常人三息的时间的时候，胸口和肚子才猛地一下，毫无预兆的塌了下去，这样往复三次之后，贺峰猛然觉得眼前一片明亮，这不是像那种刚起床时，看到的那种明亮，而是一种心神清明的明亮，而且浑身舒爽无比，比起泡药水澡来，不知舒服了多少倍。

    贺峰来到父母房间的时候，虽然还是不能做什么剧烈的运动，但是平常的行动已是完全无碍，这让贺峰自己都很是震惊于自己超强悍的恢复能力，同时，他对自己身上接连不断发生的各种怪异事情的根由，也越发的想要一探究竟起来。当然，他也不是那种喜欢钻牛角尖的人，暂时来讲，他只是想弄清楚自己的极限在哪里，对自己的真实实力有一个清醒的认识，才能够对自己有一个正确的定位，不然，若是养成了盲目的自信，一路赢下去倒还没什么大的影响，而一旦败北，那种打击，将会成为心神之中一块永远挥之不去的阴影，这是贺峰所不希望看到的。

    既然不能做什么剧烈的运动，而李纯到现在都还没有起来，贺峰也只好让月儿领着自己到外面逛逛，直到现在贺峰也是才知道，月儿早上之所以刚见到自己就怪叫一声跑掉，一是因为确实是惊喜于自己这么快就能没事；而是因为讶异于自己能够这么快就能醒来。原来贺烈为了贺峰与李纯能够彻底放松的休息一下，也为了药效能够更彻底的发挥效果，在准备的药水里和膏药里都掺了些安神的药粉，而这也是李纯之所以直到现在还一睡不起的重要原因之一。

    虽然很少外出，但其实也没有必要一定要人陪着，只是觉得既然这已是有了家人，有了朋友，那就就总该和前世那种孤独的生活有所区别才是，当然，这其中也并不排除有着某种炫耀的心理夹杂在其中，尽管并没有人明白，也没有人会知道这种炫耀，更没有人会理解这种只是带个丫鬟出来逛街的炫耀。

    贺峰就是这样一个人，低调的炫耀，不求谁能理解，更不需要谁能明白，只要自己高兴；压抑的兴奋，无所谓有没有人陪着大声的叫喊，更不会理睬别人眼中的自己到底是怎样一个人，只要自己享受；在孤独中释放自我，在落寞中享受生活。贺峰这样的生活，虽然说起来很是有种萧瑟的感觉，但其实他的生活要比很多人都要丰富精彩很多。若是想要用一些比较体面的话来形容的话，那便是：因为心无挂碍，所以勇闯四方！

    挥去心中的阴霾，重新将心思放到眼前街道上的一应事物上，贺峰看着在街上一蹦一跳的月儿，心下暖暖的，微微的笑着，心想：到底是个孩子，看来以后要多带着出来走走，还这么小，老实在家憋着，很容易憋出病来的。

    尽管现在的贺峰已经接受了自己是个孩子这个事实，但思维方式却不是他想改就能改得过来的，直到现在还是不经意间就已达人的思考方式在想问题。

    “黑马小子，黑马小子•••”突然听到几声叫喊，声音真犹如黄莺般灵动婉转，尽管在心理上，无论在哪个方面都是偏向于聂初影的内在或外在的表现，但这并不妨碍贺峰去观赏其它美好的事物。例如，现在贺峰就觉得这个声音真的是好听极了。

    “黑马小子，喊你怎么不答应？”突然一个娇小可爱的姑娘挡在自己的面前，双手掐腰，皱着眉头，气鼓鼓的对着贺峰咤问道，很显然，她对喊了那么多声都不理自己的这个“黑马小子”，很是气愤。

    “少爷，人家的名字又不是叫‘黑马小子’，你这样喊他，他哪里会知道你是在喊他嘛？”就在这时，一道沙哑的声音响起。

content_en:
Naturally, there were two loud and long-lasting screams in He Feng's room. Soaking in the potion that was prepared early, but warm and cool, it was both painful and comfortable for a while, and it was intoxicating. He Feng thought more than once that he had a masochistic tendency. However, after today's tragic fight, He Feng completely understood that he really had no masochistic tendencies. He could swear that he really had no masochistic tendencies at all.

However, something was unusual today. After the last fight, he fell asleep unknowingly while applying the medicine. But this time, although his body was lazy and didn't want to move, his spirit was not as tired as expected. Instead, his mind was still thinking about the fight just now, just like watching a movie in a cinema. The difference was that he changed from a participant to the only onlooker.

He Feng just looked at it like this. Although the other party didn't understand everything that happened to him, he was now able to accept it calmly and without fear.

And now when He Feng was watching the battle, he found that he was as if he was watching in slow motion. Not only that, he could see every action of everyone very clearly, and he could even find many places where he did not respond appropriately at the time.For example, if he had kicked the blow when he turned around and knocked down Jin Dao instead of hitting it with his knee, the effect would not only have been better, but due to the distance, he would not have been as hard and embarrassed as the fight at that time; another example is, when Wei Ming pounces on himself, if he can seize the gap, first kick down the golden road in front, and then use the force to hit Wei Ming with a heavy elbow, who is lying on the ground because of the forward pounce, it will be more energy-saving than the previous fighting method.

One thing worth mentioning is that in his conscious world, it is not like a real fight. There are many pauses in the middle. The battle process that He Feng is watching and analyzing now has no pauses. The scholar in plain robes does not appear in the middle. Therefore, He Feng only saw a very funny scene in this section.Face to face, the four people faced each other, each with an angry look on his face, but suddenly, they started to attack together in a tacit understanding, and then everyone was injured. After that, everyone was quiet and rested for a period of time. After the last blow, it was completely over. The last scene where Li Chun threatened did not appear, and as for the subsequent plot, there was no trace at all.

The replay of this battle was already in his consciousness. Although He Feng felt that he was not asleep, he had his eyes closed now. While he was enjoying this special post-war summary, he suddenly felt an inexplicable pressure. This pressure did not come from the outside world, but directly hit his mind. It frightened him inexplicably, but he could not avoid it. In just that moment, he was sweating profusely.

When he opened his eyes, a bright light suddenly came into his eyes, but it turned out that it was already dawn.He Feng stood up and stretched his muscles. He suddenly felt sore all over, as if a machine that had been rusty for a long time suddenly started to work. He Feng thought for a moment and decided not to exercise today. Instead, he would just go for a morning run and simply move his body.

When He Feng went to the ground to put on his clothes, although the pain all over his body was nothing, he still felt sore and uncomfortable every time he moved. Also, the little bit of pain felt so obvious and arrogantly abusing He Feng's nerves.

He didn't see Li Chun when he woke up this morning, so He Feng asked in passing. What he didn't expect was Yue'er's surprised cry, and then he ran away and disappeared.

After today's morning exercise started, it was no less than a fierce battle for He Feng. He was sweating profusely and his back was covered with sweat.

"I'm not a masochist, I'm not a masochist, I'm not a masochist, ••••••" He Feng kept exercising, and at the same time he kept shouting in his heart. He ran a circle with He Feng, then did a set of Tai Chi, and then continued running and doing Tai Chi...After repeating this cycle, I don't know whether the soreness in the body has really subsided or He Feng is used to it. In short, the feeling is not obvious, but he cannot stop, because as soon as he stops, he will return to the original state, and his whole body feels as uncomfortable as a machine that has been rusted for a long time.The reason why He Feng screamed loudly in his heart over and over again was because when he was exercising, the sore feeling never increased or decreased, and deep down in his heart, he actually enjoyed the sore and painful feeling. How could He Feng, who had once decisively denied that he had masochistic tendencies, stop it?But you can just shout these words in your heart, otherwise, others will not mind taking it for granted that the eldest young master of the He family is crazy.

It wasn't until He Feng ran more than 20 laps that the soreness in his body began to slowly subside. This made He Feng secretly relieved. Although He Feng was very surprised that he could run more than 20 laps today and didn't feel tired at all, it didn't mean that he was willing to keep running like this without being able to stop on his own.

After stopping, He Feng stretched his arms comfortably and assumed a posture of facing up to the sky and embracing nature. Although this metaphor is a bit narcissistic and narcissistic, for a person who is almost narcissistic, this metaphor is undoubtedly the closest to He Feng's current inner thoughts.

But He Feng didn't just do it to strike a cool pose and let others watch and worship him.He took a deep breath. He didn't know how deep it was. He could only see He Feng's chest slowly inflating like a balloon, and then his stomach again.Then it remained in such a bulging state until it took an ordinary person three breaths to take three breaths, before his chest and stomach suddenly suddenly collapsed without warning. After doing this three times, He Feng suddenly felt that his eyes were bright. This was not the kind of brightness he saw when he first got up, but a kind of brightness with a clear mind, and his whole body was extremely comfortable. It was many times more comfortable than taking a bath with medicinal water.

When He Feng came to his parents' room, although he still couldn't do any strenuous exercise, his normal actions were completely fine. This made He Feng himself shocked by his super recovery ability. At the same time, he became more and more eager to find out the root cause of the various weird things that kept happening to him.Of course, he is not the kind of person who likes to get into trouble. For the time being, he just wants to figure out where his limits are and have a clear understanding of his true strength so that he can have a correct positioning of himself. Otherwise, if he develops blind confidence, winning all the way will not have a big impact. But once he loses, the blow will become a lingering shadow in his mind, which is what He Feng does not want to see.

Since he couldn't do any strenuous exercise and Li Chun hadn't gotten up yet, He Feng had no choice but to let Yue'er lead him for a walk outside. Only now did He Feng know that the reason why Yue'er screamed and ran away as soon as she saw him in the morning was because she was really surprised that she could be okay so quickly; and because she was surprised that she could wake up so quickly.It turned out that in order for He Feng and Li Chun to completely relax and take a rest, and in order for the medicine to be more effective, He Lie mixed some soothing powder into the prepared potions and plasters. This was one of the important reasons why Li Chun still couldn't sleep until now.

Although I rarely go out, there is no need for anyone to accompany me. I just feel that since I have family and friends now, it should be different from the lonely life in my previous life. Of course, this does not rule out that there is some kind of showing off psychology mixed in. Although no one understands it, no one will know about this kind of showing off, and no one will understand this kind of showing off just taking a maid out to go shopping.

He Feng is such a person, showing off in a low-key manner, not asking anyone to understand, let alone understanding, as long as he is happy; repressed excitement, it doesn't matter whether there is someone to accompany him to shout loudly, and he doesn't care about what kind of person he is in the eyes of others, as long as he enjoys it by himself; releases himself in loneliness, and enjoys life in loneliness.Although He Feng's life sounds bleak to say the least, his life is actually much richer and more exciting than many people's.If I want to use some more decent words to describe it, it would be: because I have no worries, I bravely travel everywhere!

Shaking away the haze in his heart and focusing on the things on the street in front of him again, He Feng looked at the moon bouncing on the street, his heart warmed, and he smiled slightly, thinking: After all, he is just a child. It seems that he will be taken out for more walks in the future. He is still so young, and if he is kept at home, he will easily get sick.

Although He Feng has now accepted the fact that he is a child, his way of thinking cannot be changed if he wants to. To this day, he is still thinking about problems in a way that has become an expert inadvertently.

"Dark horse boy, dark horse boy..." Suddenly he heard several shouts, and the voices were as smart and mellow as an oriole. Although psychologically, he was biased towards Nie Chuying's internal or external performance in every aspect, this did not prevent He Feng from enjoying other beautiful things.For example, He Feng now feels that this voice is really nice.

"Dark horse boy, why don't you agree to my call?" Suddenly a petite and cute girl stood in front of her, pinched her waist with her hands, frowned, and asked He Fengzha angrily. It was obvious that she was very angry with this "dark horse boy" who ignored her after shouting so many times.

"Master, his name is not 'Black Horse Boy'. If you call him like this, how will he know that you are calling him?" At this moment, a hoarse voice sounded.
